method.definition: exact geocentric Sun-Ascendant conjunction in Washington, D.C.
method.rise_seed: solar disc centre; refraction disabled; refined to exact Sun-ASC longitude equality
method.america_authority: america_ephemeris.json; shortest signed-arc interpolation between 00:00 UTC daily rows
method.parent_routing: exact registered UTC timestamp inside each Sun-ASC interval
method.seed_chart_america_policy: include from canonical cache when covered; otherwise unresolved; never extrapolate
method.standing: The daybreak frame delivers registered governing charts; it never replaces or governs them.

experiment.title: Daybreak Almanac — daily hand-off experiment
experiment.premise: Test whether the exact Washington, D.C. Sun–Ascendant frame describes how the already-governing ingress, New Moon or eclipse chapter, and outer-planet synodic clocks are delivered between one daybreak and the next.
experiment.standing: The daybreak chart is subordinate and experimental. It has no governing standing and cannot replace the ingress → New Moon → eclipse ladder.
experiment.lens: Freedom 250 state-transition questions may guide observation, but no chart creates a finding, ranks a storyline, or proves cause.
experiment.assignment_rule: Exact-timestamp records are assigned to the Sun–ASC interval that contains their instant. Date-only records remain visibly civil-date assignments.

cohorts.label: Retrospective calibration
cohorts.basis: The Chronicle record already existed before this experiment was frozen; use it to learn the instrument, never as a prospective hit rate.

cohorts.label: Prospective 30-day watch
cohorts.basis: Factual geometry and structured watch cards are frozen before the first daybreak; grade only after each Sun–ASC interval closes.

dispositions.label: Lines up
dispositions.definition: The record clearly expresses the frozen structural question without needing a new story after the fact.

dispositions.label: Partial
dispositions.definition: Some of the structure appears, but the match is incomplete, mixed, or materially weaker than the watch implied.

dispositions.label: Miss
dispositions.definition: The expected structural hand-off is not present in the closed interval's record.

dispositions.label: Counterevidence
dispositions.definition: The record materially points the other way and should challenge the reading or the method.

dispositions.label: Unresolved
dispositions.definition: The interval is open, the record is too thin, or the evidence cannot yet support a disposition.

watch_questions: Which actor or function is carrying the daily Ascendant ruler and its dispositor root?
Do tight contacts to the governing ingress describe continuity, pressure, or a visible hand-off in the standing state question?
Do contacts to the ruling New Moon or eclipse describe what is seeded, revealed, or brought to delivery inside the chapter?
Do active Long Clock aspects or seed echoes add a useful era-level backdrop without swallowing the daily evidence?
What stayed unchanged, failed, reversed, or contradicted the chart?

geometry_ref_contract.resolution: geometry_index[ref] yields an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into this payload
geometry_ref_contract.structural_mirror_policy: Daybreak Sun and ASC are definitionally co-located; paired hits use one SunASC mirror_family_id/reference_id and count as one occurrence
